Maya — thanks for the clear summary and for the template. Short answer: yes on staged invoicing / holdback, with a few options depending on risk and cadence. I looped in Vivek (finance) and Priyom (sales ops) to confirm specifics for AP/ERP mapping.

Quick options we typically offer for enterprise PO-driven deals:

1) Option A — Monthly consolidated invoicing (default)
   - Net45 terms; one invoice per month that includes the PO number in the invoice filename as you require.
   - No holdback; good for standard committed blocks.

2) Option B — Milestone / staged invoices (recommended for Q4 committed ramp)
   - Invoices tied to milestones (e.g., activation, 50% usage milestone, final acceptance).
   - 10% holdback on final invoice until acceptance — Redwood can accept this, we’ll need the milestone definitions in the SOW/commitment doc.
   - Net45 for each invoice; invoices will include BU_CODE and PROJECT_ID fields in the invoice metadata.

3) Option C — Weekly sweep (usage-driven)
   - For high-frequency consumption (weekly), finance asks for a 1) credit review or 2) short prepay (we typically see 10–30% prepay depending on exposure).
   - Requires weekly invoice file naming standard (we can match your PO number rule).

Action items for us to proceed:
- Vivek: confirm whether weekly sweep can be approved with a 25% prepay or needs credit committee review.
- Priyom: suggest wording for the Commitment_Letter to capture milestone triggers and the 10% holdback.
- Maya: can you send the final BU_CODE / PROJECT_ID values and the AP remit email so we can populate AP spec?

Attaching a draft Commitment_Letter template and our required invoice metadata fields for AP ingestion.

Vanessa / Maya — quick finance note from our side. We can support Option B (milestone/staged invoices) under the following constraints:

- Net45 is acceptable.
- For staged/milestone invoicing we require clear milestone definitions (dates or usage thresholds) and a final acceptance clause for the 10% holdback.
- Weekly sweep will trigger a credit exposure check. If BlueOak wants weekly billing without a credit hold, we would request a 25% prepayment to mitigate short-term exposure.
- Mandatory invoice metadata fields for our billing system: PO_NUMBER, BU_CODE, PROJECT_ID, REMIT_ENTITY, TAX_ID, GL_CODE (if provided). Missing GL_CODE becomes a default mapping and may delay AP ingestion.
- Please include the PO_NUMBER in the PDF filename and in the invoice PDF header (some ERPs reject files otherwise).

I've attached our AP ingest spec and an example mapping spreadsheet for BlueOak to fill. If you can provide the BU_CODE and PROJECT_ID values, we will create a mapping to your ERP and return a test invoice so AP can validate ingestion.
